name: Tachibana Junnosuke
source: The protagonist who is a proud virgin and believes that there can't be sex without love. As he stays on Seiran Island and dodges the "SS" committee, he launches the "NLNS (No Love, No Sex)" campaign in order to rebel against the island's deranged laws and customs.
translation: The protagonist who is a proud virgin and believes that there can't be sex without love. As he stays on Seiran Island and dodges the "SS" committee, he launches the "NLNS (No Love, No Sex)" campaign in order to rebel against the island's deranged laws and customs.
